intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for TelemetryHistoryRepository. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Stream Processing & History. Outbound port of the append-only raw history. Dedup identity is the natural identity (deviceId, metric, tDevice) owned here; rows and revisions are never updated or deleted; first revision number is 1 (single owner of that fact). Imports only reactor, java.*, and domain types.

methods.semantics: Emits the generated sample id; EMPTY when a sample with the same identity (deviceId, metric, tDevice) is already stored (at-least-once dedup).

methods.signature: Mono<Integer> appendRevision(long sampleId, RevisionReason reason, double value, Instant tIngress)
methods.semantics: Appends an Event Revision and emits its revision number; the first revision of a sample is 1, then incremented by 1.
Greatest stored tDevice for the device and metric; EMPTY when nothing stored.

methods.signature: Flux<TelemetrySample> findWindow(String deviceId, MetricKind metric, Instant from, Instant to, int limit)
methods.semantics: Samples with from <= tDevice <= to ordered ascending by tDevice (never tIngress), at most limit rows.
